card.name: Quantity words before countable things
card.fires_on: The word "of" after "number", or words like "fewer", "many" and "more", right where a count of items is about to be named. The next word is usually a countable noun such as children, doses, cigarettes or places.

modes.label: number of
modes.description: The word "of" right after "number", before the thing being counted.
modes.example: and with the number<< of>> cigarettes smoked.

modes.label: fewer / many / more
modes.description: Comparative or quantity words that lead into a plural countable noun.
modes.example: using<< fewer>> doses than the currently licensed vaccine.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward countable-unit nouns like steps, layers, stages and periods.
card.plain: It fires when the text is about to say how many of something, such as the number of doses or children.
